verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage runs screening, risk scoring and AI agents, so measuring model precision and recall and running shadow-mode trials is a fair question for this product. The evidence pack documents neither. Exportable case data with analyst decisions and multiple screening configurations are only building blocks or adjacent features that a user could assemble into their own analysis. They are not a product capability for model-performance metrics or shadow evaluation of new models or rules.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I can measure the model itself — precision and recall on my traffic, shadow-mode trials of new models or rules before they take over decisions
